analysis_status: post-results descriptive arithmetic; no new strategy run or independent statistical test
source_hash_policy: source text hashes normalize UTF-8/LF line endings for Git checkouts; generating-checkout raw artifact hashes remain separate

definitions.round_trips: entries only when every window is flat and filled sides equal 2 * entries
definitions.frequency: entries or filled sides / eligible windows; not portfolio notional turnover
definitions.ratios: aggregate period totals / actual completed trades, never an unweighted average of yearly ratios
definitions.rounding: recorded slippage minus filled sides * adverse ticks * recorded tick value; aggregate residual under the fill model
definitions.cost_curve: G - R*C; nonnegative total dollar cost per completed trip; same assumed path; no changes to fills, delay, spread, queueing or impact
definitions.positive_budget: G/R > 0 allows positive net only for C < G/R; it is not an estimated executable cost
definitions.nonpositive_budget: G/R <= 0 admits no nonnegative cost producing positive net; a negative budget is not an achievable remedy
definitions.delay: different delays are separate saved paths; a cost-only curve does not predict their effect
